item.title: Ecuador agrees to pay Chevron after tribunal ruling as Amazon communities condemn ‘defeat for justice’
item.description: Ecuador’s plan to send $220 million to Chevron under an ISDS award draws fierce backlash from Indigenous groups, human rights advocates, and lawyers who say the ruling rewards corporate pollution.

item.title: Just like a Hegseth (thank you, Mr. Dylan)
item.description: A display of manly leadership to justify a failing regime?

item.title: The next wars are always here
item.description: Because the next wars were always here, looming. We just need the clarity to see them and the force to stop them before they begin.

item.title: Sanders demands senate scrutiny of RFK Jr. over war on science
item.description: Senate Democrats say Kennedy has undermined scientific agencies as preventable diseases surge.
